title: Algerian Bao Dessert
description: A unique dessert recipe that combines the earthy flavors of earthy ingredients with the gooey sweetness of butter.

ingredients.name: Earthy Ingredients (e.g. Mushrooms, Herbs)
ingredients.notes: Dried and ground earthy ingredients for added flavor

ingredients.name: Gooey Butter
ingredients.notes: Soft and melted butter for drizzling

ingredients.name: Almond
ingredients.notes: Sliced or slivered almonds for garnish

instructions: Bake the Algerian Bao for 10-12 minutes, or until lightly golden.
In a small pan, melt the gooey butter over low heat.
Add the earthy ingredients to the melted butter and stir to combine.
Drizzle the earthy butter mixture over the baked bao.
Sprinkle sliced almonds over the top for garnish.
